querySql:
select 
                                      object_id,
                                      s_info_windcode,
                                      f_unit_rpstartdate,
                                      f_unit_rpenddate,
                                      f_unit_startshares,
                                      f_unit_purchase,
                                      f_unit_redemption,
                                      f_unit_endshares,
                                      trade_dt,
                                      f_unit_startshares_total,
                                      f_unit_endshares_total,
                                      f_unit_purchase_total,
                                      f_unit_redemption_total,
                                      is_merge_data,
                                      opdate,
                                      opmode,
                                      to_char(sysdate - 1, 'yyyymmdd') as bath_dt,
                                      cast(sysdate as timestamp) as data_ins_time,
                                      'w_chinamutualfundpchredm.json' as task_rs_id
                                from ${srcoradbname}.chinamutualfundpchredm WHERE f_unit_rpstartdate BETWEEN '${busi_month}'||'01' AND to_char(add_months(to_date('${busi_month}'||'01','yyyyMMdd'),1)-1,'yyyyMMdd')
